Prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.

Result and scope

has the conditional exact-native-complex witness
 b = 0.001595676284575998624254
 kappa = 0.001593134158181640.
Its separately admitted conservative-complex witness is
 b = 0.001595676281828849775453
 kappa = 0.001593134155443237.
These statements retain the inherited all-size compiler, common-label and
mutable-source realization, whole-invocation hosting, precision/tape/exact
recovery, external-row, H1-H5 and analytic transfer assumptions. They do not
assert an unconditional multiplication theorem or a practical speedup.

reviewed in rohanarun PR559, head 000ede8d8354bbf2e1f0f881d0a668dac979d953.

The present review consumes that preserved source analysis and freshly checks

It does not claim a new download or proof of the inherited arbitrary-size

Why no complex exceptional-residue surcharge is present

Every selected native complex word is an exact Gaussian-dyadic scalar and
Clifford construction. Its paid frame transitions, reflected orientations,
phase representatives and residual wrappers are operator identities. Its fixed
binary orthogonal owner chart acts on the complete retained finite orthogonal
cover by right translation, which is a bijection. Provider dispatch is fixed
for each complete schedule position; neither the selected provider nor its
schedule depends on a cover vertex or residue class. Thus this particular
three-provider composition introduces no exceptional subset of complex cover
vertices. The normalized complex moment is precisely

 sum_r H[r] * (r/73)^(1-b) / 7168.

Only the extraneous bit-style complex fallback is removed. The unchanged PR543
bit supplier retains its full bad-residue surcharge, its local-ring selector
conditions and separate compiler obligations. All complex paid children,
positive idle remainders, scalar/Horner work, wrappers, phases, finite group
stock and routers, precision, fixed tape and external rows remain charged.

Fresh literal admission

All 72 complete invocations use one of three actual one-cold providers:
 rank5_zero_cold 15, rank5_four_cold 2, rank5_eight_cold 55.
Every helper index, ordered width and selected reflected program is bound to
its actual provider bytes. Helper 270 has width 8 in every provider; the width
inventories are {4:p,5:56-p,8:157,9:291} for p=0,4,8. Each provider has 504 helpers,
213 entering helpers and entrance rank 381+p. No width histogram substitutes
for an actual local word.

The supplied local admission independently checks all 728 arbitrary columns in
both reflected orientations, including all 504 dirty helper columns and erased
private center/coefficient work, both native frame ledgers, all 2,929 literal
phase edges and 224 endpoints. The controller audit rebinds those canonical
words, emitted program hashes, paid profiles, exact phase recipes and normalized
residual adapters. Both orientations of each provider have 21,486 actual events
and 16,291 scalar macros. The complete selected primitive count is
11615712, including coefficient work
5751952.

The independent serialized controller audit imports no emitter or optimizer.
It reconstructs all 36288 whole-helper owner roles, their
individual-bridge availability windows, per-replica event order, one whole
physical owner per helper during the complete invocation, disjoint residual
slots, spectator axes and all 2962 actual orthogonal
73-column chart types. It finds 29514 cross-replica roles,
15336 entering roles and 4204 positive idle
remainders. Every full cover invocation remains indivisible. The complete
literal paid profile is

 {'1': 166568, '2': 30928, '3': 35756, '4': 13696, '5': 4032, '6': 4032, '7': 172, '8': 576, '48': 1668}.

Its rank mass is 520704, live stock 7168, physical stock 7682 and deficit 2560.
The positive idle profile is {3:2364,7:172,48:1668}. No bank or uncharged helper
family is added. Sixteen controller mutation controls are rejected, including
stale providers, program hashes, wrong owner windows/widths/charts and missing
cold-helper wrapper bindings.

The fresh finite invoice sums all 72 selected provider/orientation programs and
normalization wrappers. It uses conservative shared compiler maxima and fully
charges the retained finite orthogonal group, family stock and routers. It also
retains the prior complete invoice allowance as an extra overcharge. All nine
finite checks pass. Prefix 225 is below 512; the physical row
coefficient 16467 is below 20161; the required
C0 bits 200012 are below 210000; the largest child obeys
73^2=5329 > 2*48^2=4608.

Exact arithmetic and hardened admission

Both independent rational power engines accept the conservative endpoint and
the native endpoint above, and reject each adjacent 10^-24 supplier endpoint.
The cited unchanged PR543 bit cap is 0.001653826988146798944268, with its surcharge retained.
Seven explicit bootstrap steps and all 47 strict outer inequalities produce
each stated 18-decimal kappa witness. Each next 10^-18 grid point is rejected by
that witness; zero eta/beta and unit beta controls are rejected.

The assembler first checks the complete conservative admission, moments and
outer witness, then applies the native correction. It independently binds
ordered per-helper widths, each selected call and orientation, exact program
and source artifact hashes, scalar and wrapper counts, prefix envelopes,
finite compiler arithmetic, complete paid profiles and all physical counts.
The phase-review semantic hash removes only its seconds field; all substantive
phase data stay pinned. Fresh raw phase-review hashes still bind actual source
bytes in both controller and invoice. Six deterministic source artifacts retain
full byte pins, including the actual Clifford recipes.
All 54 rebound admission mutations are rejected. These
include synchronized forged recipe hashes, a cold width permutation preserving
the inventory, and self-consistent stale no-cold wrapper totals. A stale digest
is never used as the sole reason for rejection of an altered receipt.

The old complex-surcharge model rejects the new native endpoint. Omitting the
bit surcharge invalidates its claimed adjacent-endpoint rejection. These two
model controls isolate exactly which recurrence changes and which remains.

Remaining assumptions and attribution

This finite audit does not enumerate the enormous full orthogonal group; the
actual finite charts and the exact translation-bijection argument are distinct.
It does not prove arbitrary-size realization, common-label synthesis, mutable
source/local-ring compiler contracts, precision-to-exact-recovery transfer, or
H1-H5. Those inherited obligations remain explicit. The changed local words,
controller, invoice and arithmetic are all separately evidenced.

Provenance retains the icekylinx exact Clifford/complex-cover notes and prior
compiler/hosting work, PR558/PR552 rank-five provider lineage, the frozen PR561
eight-plus-cold word, and eumemic PR543 for the unchanged bit supplier. The
native recurrence correction follows rohanarun PR559. This all 72 one-cold
application and independent review were prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance.
No previously published head or claim was changed.

The packaged verifier reconstructs the same fixed words, call dispatch and owner assignment. Its final template/receipt hashes bind newly generated phase timing metadata; all deterministic artifact hashes and all phase semantics (excluding only elapsed seconds) remain frozen in the assembler. Final ASSEMBLY.json and RECEIPT.json identify that replay. The unchanged current PR559 head d858c0b2edcc704ef370b3c96dc51a75439b77b0 is vendored in full, with its source notices and the original exact-cover notes.
